::: {#intro}
B.Tech student in Robotics and Autonomous Systems at Plaksha University, passionate about mechatronics, aerospace, and control engineering. My interests lie in designing and integrating complex electromechanical systems, with a focus on low-level control, system modelling, and hardware development.

My work spans mechanical design, embedded systems, sensors and actuators, control algorithms, and UAV development. I enjoy taking ideas from concept to reality through hands-on fabrication and prototyping, using techniques such as 3D printing, laser cutting, soldering, and mechanical assembly etc.

Outside engineering, I spend much of my time flying FPV drones, exploring freestyle and cinematic flying. Check out my flying here [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/@im15hu)
:::
